content.comment_body: Is it possible to use [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 8?

Yes, you can. Refer to [url] for more details; it indicates installation is possible on Windows 7 (both 32 and 64 bit). Note that Windows 8 closely resembles Windows 7 and there aren’t any major differences. I’ve successfully installed it on a Windows 8 64-bit build (customer preview) and it works well.
